_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Nyewe {player_id} le asɔɖe Liar's Dice si wɔ {num_players} me.

Dzɔdzɔwo:
- Le wo ŋkeke me, awoe nye be:
  1) Dɔ bid yeye si sɔgbɔ ɖe dzɔdzɔ sia, alo dzɔdzɔ si sɔgbɔ ɖe dzɔdzɔ sia (alo hɔe wɔawo), abe '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Yɔ bid si detɔ gbɔ '[Call]'.

Eyi wɔ yɔ bid la:
  - Eyi dzɔdzɔ sia wɔ mɔ si wɔ dɔ la ɖe dzɔdzɔ sia, dzɔdzɔ sia si dɔ la gblɔe la kɔe.
  - Ela, yɔɖɔƒe la kɔe.
Ame si wɔ kɔe 0 wɔawo la, woa dzo. Ame si wɔ megbe la, woa ɖo.

board.new_round:
Nuxɔxɔ si round - Dɔ si dice he: {dice_summary}
Dɔ si dice si he na wɔ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Nyewe {current_player_id} yɔ bid! Dzɔdzɔ sia wɔ mɔ si {face_value} nye {count}, si nye kɛ {quantity}.
Nyewe {loser_id} (dzɔdzɔ sia si dɔ la) gblɔe la kɔe.
call.caller_loses:
Dɔdzikpɔla {current_player_id} ɖe call! Nuxɔxɔ kɔkɔ si face {face_value} wɔ na ɖi {count}, si wɔ >= {quantity}.
Dɔdzikpɔla {loser_id} (he si ɖe call na ɖo) yi na dɔ si die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Womeƒle nu le esi womele asi kpem ɖe eŋu do ŋgɔ o ta.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Nunana si ŋu viɖe mele o: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action si wɔ na ɖi na ɖe bid na ɖo '[Bid: X, Y]' kple '[Call]'. Action si wɔ ɖe: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ne agbɔsɔsɔ yeye {new_quantity} la le sue wu esi li fifia si nye {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Face value yeye {new_face_value} nye lower kple current {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Nu si wotsɔna ƒlea nui la sɔ kple esi wozãna fifia.
bid_reason.face_range: Ele be eƒe xexlẽdzesi nanɔ 1 kple 6 dome.

message.eliminated_invalid: Woɖe fefewɔla {player_id} le esi wògbe be yemate ŋu awɔ dɔ o ta.

outcome.win: Dɔdzikpɔla {winner} yi! Ranking si he na ɖo: {final_ranking}
